1. Cancelling a subscription

You can cancel at any time, for any reason, without giving a reason.

How: use the subscription-management link in the receipt you were sent by [TODO: merchant of record] (the payment provider's customer portal), or email hasib107040@gmail.com from the address you used at purchase.

What happens:

  • Cancellation stops future renewals. It is not a refund of the current term.
  • You keep full access until the end of the term you have already paid for.
  • At the end of that term the extension stops advancing videos. Your settings are kept, and come back the moment a subscription is active again.

We do not use cancellation dark patterns. There is no retention flow you must click through, no phone call, and no "are you sure" chain.

2. Refunds

2.1 EU / UK / EEA consumers — statutory right of withdrawal

If you are a consumer in the EU, the UK, or the EEA, you normally have 14 days to withdraw from a distance contract without giving a reason.

For digital content supplied immediately, that right can be waived. Where our checkout asks for that waiver, it reads:

"I request immediate access to Thumbless and acknowledge that I therefore lose my 14-day right of withdrawal once access begins."

We honour the 14-day right anyway for the first purchase on an account, whether or not that box was shown or ticked, provided the request reaches us within 14 days of purchase. We would rather refund an unhappy customer than argue about a waiver.

To withdraw, email hasib107040@gmail.com with the email address used at purchase. You may use the model withdrawal form in §6, but you do not have to.

2.2 Everyone else — our voluntary policy

Outside the statutory cases we still refund in these situations:

SituationWhat we do
Within 14 days of your first purchaseFull refund, no questions
The Service does not work for you and we cannot fix itFull refund of the current term
A supported site stopped working and we did not restore it within 30 daysPro-rata refund of the unused term
We removed a feature material to your planPro-rata refund of the unused term
We discontinue the ServiceSee Terms §11
Accidental renewal you did not intend, reported within 7 days, unusedFull refund of that term
Duplicate chargeFull refund of the duplicate, always

2.3 When we may decline

  • Requests made long after the term began, where the Service was used normally throughout.
  • Repeated refund-and-repurchase cycles on the same account or payment method.
  • Where the account was terminated for breach of the Terms (Terms §4).
  • Chargebacks filed without contacting us first — we will respond to the bank with our records. Please email us instead; it is faster for both of us.

3. How a refund is paid

  • Refunds go back to the original payment method. We cannot send them anywhere else.
  • Your bank or card issuer decides how long it takes to appear — typically 5–10 business days after it is issued.
  • Refunds are issued in the currency of the original charge. We are not responsible for exchange-rate differences or your bank's fees.
  • Our payment provider, [TODO: merchant of record], is the merchant of record: they issue the refund and adjust any tax on it.

4. Response times

We aim to answer every refund request within 2 business days and to have approved refunds issued within 5 business days.

If you have not heard from us in 5 business days, email again — the first message almost certainly went to spam, and we would rather hear from you twice than lose you.

5. The free trial

Every install starts with a 7-day free trial of the complete product. No card is taken, no payment details are stored, and nothing is ever charged for the trial — so there is nothing to refund. When the trial ends the extension simply stops advancing videos until a subscription is active; your settings are kept.

The trial never converts into a paid term by itself. A subscription starts only when you buy one.
